text:
Spec-model deviation: the cross-repo coordination epic's sub-tasks for non-home repos (livespec, livespec-runtime, livespec-impl-plaintext) were filed in livespec-dev-tooling's work-items.jsonl rather than each consumer repo's own JSONL store. Per livespec/SPECIFICATION/contracts.md §'Cross-repo dependency awareness', work-items should live where the work happens with typed DependsOnEntry cross-repo links.

Reason for the shortcut: capture-work-item's interactive UI only accepts local `li-` ids for depends_on (the typed union isn't exposed there), so modeling per-repo trees with sibling_work_item links would have required either bypassing the skill entirely (which the driver prompt explicitly did) or implementing the typed-link UI first.

When to revisit: if/when the central-store ergonomics get painful (e.g., people working on individual sibling repos can't see the relevant items from their repo's store) — file a propose-change against contracts.md §'Cross-repo dependency awareness' to formalize either the central-store pattern as legal or the typed-link UI as required.
